tools.name: company_info
tools.description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). The company: name, country and city, currency, languages, contacts, clients' rating, the districts it serves (main: fast arrival; secondary: next day or a call-out fee), today's date in its time zone and its booking page.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). Every service with its starting price, how long it takes, whether it can be booked, and the questions the client answers (they set the price and the time). Questions may depend on an earlier answer (shown_if). "unknown_allowed" means "?

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). Checks the client's answers and gives the price and the duration. If an answer is missing or wrong, "problem" says which question.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). Free start times for the service (with these answers and units — they set how long the work takes) over the next days, from tomorrow. Each time has a slot_id for book_appointment. Times are the company's local time.

tools.name: diagnose
tools.description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). A preliminary hint by the air conditioner's brand and the error code on its display: the probable cause (a breakdown type) and the company's starting price for it. It is not a diagnosis. tools.description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). Books the visit at a free time from check_availability. tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). For a job that needs a quote, not a fixed price: sends the company the client's description of the job (what, where, how big, how urgent), their contact and address, and links to photos if the client gave any. tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). Where a booking stands: status, time, technician (once assigned), price. Needs the token from book_appointment.

tools.name: cancel_request
tools.description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). Cancels the booking (only when the client asked to). Needs the token from book_appointment.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "diagnose" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
